By this application, appellant seeks regular suspension of sentence and bail during the pendency of appeal.
The appellant has been convicted in Session's Case No.440351/2016 arising out of FIR No.929/2007 under Section 498A/304B/34 IPC registered at police station Dwarka, Delhi.

The appellant has been sentenced to ten years RI with fine of Rs.10,000/- under Section 304B IPC and three years RI with fine of Rs.5,000/- under Section 498A IPC.

sentences.text: Further medical status report of appellant is highlighted.
The medical report dated 10.05.2023 notes:-

On 21/04/2023, inmate patient was examined by jail visiting Eye SR with complaint of pain in both eye, for which he was advised appropriate treatment accordingly and further advised to keep his blood pressure in check.

Thereafter on 26/04/2023, inmate patient was examined by jail visiting Medicine SR as a follow up case of hypertension with complaint of pain bilateral leg and advised appropriate treatment accordingly.

Thereafter on same day i.e. 26/04/2023, inmate patient was examined by jail visiting Psychiatry SR with complaint of decreased sleep, headache, weakness while walking,
palpitation and advised appropriate treatment accordingly.

Thereafter on 08/05/2023, inmate patient was brought by co-inmate at 12:00 noon in emergency on wheel chair with complaint of slurring of speech, shallow breathing and difficulty in deglutition with numbness of left side of body, on examination he was found to be not fully oriented, left pupil sluggishly reacting and high BP, for which he was given emergency primary treatment and immediately referred towards DDU Hospital with nursing orderly.
As per information received patient was referred towards Safdarjung Hospital from DDU Hospital for specialized care.

Today i.e. 10/05/2023, at the time of report writing as per information available inmate patient is admitted and receiving treatment as a case of brain steam bleed.
4.

Considering the report the appellant is still admitted and is receiving treatment as a case of brain steam bleed and also the custody of the appellant, I admit the appellant to interim bail as of now for his treatment for a period of 12 weeks from the date of his release on his executing a personal bond of Rs.20,000/- with one surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Trial Court/Duty Magistrate.
